rv.q: For audiences who love heavy metal rock music, this is the play to see.
Airness, now playing at the Citadel Theatre, delivers a rocking good time, laughs, and a rock classic earworm to follow you home.

Joe Lehman’s direction, Jake Ganzer’s choreography and Air Guitar Consultant’s (yes, that is a real thing) Gina “Rocky Rhodes” Czarkowski instruction came together to teach these actors, none of whom had even done air guitar before, to not only do air guitar moves, but to do them believably as separate characters.
Airness is not the greatest script ever, but it definitely has its moments.
